about: 2.54 smart chart lines (Mandeep, 11 Nov 2026: 'make some smart system that can draw lines on the chart by itself analysing each and everything that matters'). Bullets for live/linesmith.py (the line finder) and lab/levelbook.py (the line book: how often each kind of line held or broke on your own 1-minute history, by how price came to it). A touch counts when price was at least away_pct from the line and then came within touch_pct of it; HOLD = it then moved move_pct back the way it came before closing brk_pct beyond the line; BREAK = it closed brk_pct beyond and then travelled move_pct beyond; within 60 minutes. Random lines are the baseline: a line only 'matters' when it holds or breaks clearly more often than random lines in the same situation, in both the older (train) and the newer (holdout) years.
